ask.description: The ask id from the chief's list or batch. Not needed for list.

result.description: close: the ask is done. merge: it is the same as another open ask. send: a session should answer it. owner: the owner must decide it. list: show the asks waiting for you.

into.description: For merge: the open ask id to merge into.

to.description: For send: the session id that should answer it.

reason.description: Why, in one line. Required for a sort, not for list.

why_you.description: For owner: why only the owner can decide it.
